name: Johannes Kepler University Linz
summary: Campus university in Linz with six English-taught bachelor's, from Artificial Intelligence to chemistry, business and a new quantum degree.

ib.text: No IB points rule is published. English-taught degrees need English B2: IB English A at 4+, or English B at 5 (HL) or 6 (SL). C1 needs English A at 6+ or English B HL at 7.

dates.label: General admission period for the winter semester ends (same date every year)
Non-EU/EEA window for the winter semester closes (same date every year)

programmes.name: Artificial Intelligence
programmes.ib: English B2; no German needed. Parts can be studied remotely from Vienna or Bregenz, but exams mean you must also be in Linz.

programmes.name: Biological Chemistry
programmes.ib: English B2. Semesters 3 and 4 are at the University of South Bohemia in České Budějovice, Czechia.

programmes.name: Chemistry and Chemical Technology
programmes.ib: English B2; no German certificate, but some first-year courses are held in German.

programmes.name: International Business Administration
programmes.ib: English C1, plus a second foreign language (German, Italian, French or Spanish) at B1 on entry. A semester abroad is compulsory.

programmes.name: Quantum Science and Technology
programmes.ib: English B2. New: planned to start in autumn 2027, pending approval by the JKU Senate.

programmes.name: Transformation Studies. Art x Science
programmes.ib: English B2 and an admission procedure run by the University of Applied Arts Vienna, in January–February 2027; details due in autumn 2026.

notes: Most other JKU bachelor's, including Computer Science, are taught in German and need German at B2 or C1.
Transformation Studies is run with the University of Applied Arts Vienna, whose admission procedure for the October 2027 start is in January–February 2027.
